subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "Why have you been absent from the class for a long time? Your exam is knocking at the door," said the teacher angrily. "Sorry, Sir, I will never be irregular again," said Raju. "Actually I have been suffering from Dengue fever." "Be regular from now on," the teacher said.
guide_solution: It helps us to be healthy and keep fit.
